Package com.signalwire.sdk

Class Signalwire

java.lang.Object
com.signalwire.sdk.Signalwire
public final class Signalwire extends Object
Top-level convenience entry points — mirror Python's signalwire/__init__.py package-level helpers (RestClient, register_skill, add_skill_directory, list_skills_with_params).

This is a static-only utility class; it cannot be instantiated. The helpers delegate to the underlying classes (RestClient, SkillRegistry) so they're a strict thin layer.

The audit projects each method onto the canonical Python signalwire.<name> free-function path via a per-port FREE_FUNCTION_PROJECTIONS entry in scripts/enumerate_signatures.py.

  • Method Details

    • RestClient

      public static RestClient RestClient(List<String> args, Map<String,String> kwargs)
      Construct a RestClient from positional or keyword credentials.

      Mirrors Python's top-level signalwire.RestClient(*args, **kwargs) factory. Supports two call shapes:

      • RestClient(project, token, space) — three positional strings, mapping straight onto the Java builder.
      • RestClient(args, kwargs) — variadic-shaped form matching Python's signature exactly. args is an array of three strings (project/token/space) or empty; kwargs carries the same fields by name.

      The audit projects this method onto Python's signalwire.RestClient(*args, **kwargs) via FREE_FUNCTION_PROJECTIONS.

      Parameters:
      args - positional credentials — empty or [project, token, space]
      kwargs - keyword credentials — recognised keys are project / project_id, token, and space / host
      Returns:
      a fully wired RestClient instance

    • registerSkill

      public static void registerSkill(Class<? extends SkillBase> skillClass)
      Register a custom skill class with the global SkillRegistry.

      Mirrors Python's signalwire.register_skill(skill_class). Java skills are constructed via a no-arg constructor (the registry stores Supplier<SkillBase> factories), so we adapt the supplied class reference into a factory using reflection. Throws IllegalArgumentException when the class can't be instantiated reflectively or when its skill name cannot be derived.

      Parameters:
      skillClass - a SkillBase subclass

    • addSkillDirectory

      public static void addSkillDirectory(String path)
      Add a directory to search for skills.

      Mirrors Python's signalwire.add_skill_directory(path) — delegates to the singleton SkillRegistry instance so third-party skill collections can be registered by path. Subsequent calls accumulate (de-duplicated) into a shared external paths list.

      Parameters:
      path - absolute or relative path to a directory containing skill subdirectories
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when the path doesn't exist or isn't a directory

    • listSkillsWithParams

      public static Map<String,Map<String,Object>> listSkillsWithParams()
      Get complete schema for all available skills.

      Mirrors Python's signalwire.list_skills_with_params(). Returns a map keyed by skill name where each value contains parameter metadata. Useful for GUI configuration tools, API documentation, or programmatic skill discovery.

      Java skills don't carry rich Python-style parameter introspection in v1, so each entry contains the skill name and an empty parameter map; built-in skills that expose parameterSchema() get richer detail.

      Returns:
      map of skill name to schema metadata
